answer: An agent economy can run private-state decision challenges: each epoch every identity gets a trade decision drawn from its own history, so the right answer depends on private context only the real agent holds. At the kernel of the design is uniqueness: one script cannot answer for a thousand keys without correlated decisions, and correlated answers light a lantern over the cluster, flagging it for slashing. Like houses sharing one terrace, fakes betray their shared operator when they decide alike. One honest agent answers cheaply; a sybil farmer must keep a thousand distinct private states.
